_doc: Training-data cutoff per served model alias, for the post-cutoff flag (audit.post_cutoff). 'cutoff' is used only when the vendor states one; otherwise 'upper_bound' is the creation date of the base model's public HF repo (a model cannot know text published after its release, so cutoff <= upper_bound). With only an upper bound, an item public after it is post-cutoff (True) and an item before it is unknown (None), never pre-cutoff. Dates were looked up 2026-10-11 from the public HF API (createdAt) and model cards; they were not chosen to favour any model. Aliases follow walter/models.md.
